title: Food Packaging: Principles and Practice, 3rd Edition
notes: Comprehensive foundational reference on barrier polymer permeation physics, Arrhenius kinetics, shelf-life modeling, and food degradation mechanisms.

title: The Commercial Storage of Fruits, Vegetables, and Florist and Nursery Stocks (Agriculture Handbook 66)
authors: Kenneth C. Gross, Chien Yi Wang, Mikal Saltveit
notes: Authoritative USDA postharvest storage guidelines, respiration rates at reference temperatures, chilling sensitivity, and relative humidity recommendations.

title: Postharvest Technology of Horticultural Crops, 3rd Edition
notes: Definitive guide on modified atmosphere packaging (MAP) gas tolerances, critical oxygen extinction thresholds, and physiological injury from carbon dioxide.

title: Fish and Fishery Products Hazards and Controls Guidance, 4th Edition
authors: US Food and Drug Administration Center for Food Safety and Applied Nutrition
notes: Regulatory guidelines establishing the 4.6 pH threshold and refrigeration controls required for preventing Clostridium botulinum in reduced-oxygen packaging.

title: Standard Test Method for Oxygen Gas Transmission Rate Through Plastic Film and Sheeting Using a Coulometric Sensor
authors: ASTM International Committee D20 on Plastics
notes: Standardized test method for steady-state OTR determination at 23 deg C and 0% relative humidity using coulometric detection.

title: Standard Test Method for Water Vapor Transmission Rate Through Plastic Film and Sheeting Using a Modulated Infrared Sensor
authors: ASTM International Committee F02 on Primary Barrier Packaging
notes: Standardized test method for steady-state WVTR determination at 37.8 deg C and 90% relative humidity gradient using infrared sensor.

title: Modelling respiration rate to inform modified atmosphere packaging of fresh produce
authors: S. C. Fonseca, F. A. R. Oliveira, J. K. Brecht
notes: Mathematical respiration modeling, Q10 Arrhenius temperature scaling, and equilibrium gas balance in perforated EMAP packaging.

title: Food Packaging—Roles, Materials, and Environmental Issues
notes: Comparative review of polymer packaging materials, barrier performance, aluminum foil laminates, bio-based films, and recycling classifications.
